mentions.name: PGlite
mentions.description: PGlite is PostgreSQL compiled to WebAssembly, an embeddable database that runs in-browser and server-side. Roadmap items include easier PostgreSQL version upgrades, PostGIS extension support (already running server-side in Node, Bun and Deno but blocked by Chrome), multi-connection multiplexing over a single instance, and a native library.
